name: tage-sc-l-8kb
description: csim TAGE-SC-L sized after the CBP-5 2016 8 KB configuration (15 history lengths 4..1000, 4 Ki-entry bimodal, 2-bit u, 2 allocations, 8-entry loop predictor).

approximations: csim uses one table per history length; the reference uses shared bank-interleaved tables
the statistical corrector is smaller and simpler than the reference one
bimodal hysteresis is not shared between entries
the bimodal table has 2 Ki two-bit entries; the reference has 4 Ki entries with shared hysteresis
